ValidationRule.description: User roles that do not have access to FraudX type case cannot relate a FraudX case to current Dispute case.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'ATM_Dispute', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Card_Dispute', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Direct_Debit_Dispute', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Direct_Entry_Dispute', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'NPP_Dispute' ), ISCHANGED( ParentId ), OR( Parent.RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Fraud', Parent.RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Identity', Parent.RecordType.DeveloperName = 'KYC_QA', Parent.RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Recipient_Mule', Parent.RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Scam' ), OR( $UserRole.DeveloperName = 'Coach', $UserRole.DeveloperName = 'Coach_Lead', $UserRole.DeveloperName = 'Content_Writer', $UserRole.DeveloperName = 'Quality_Analyst', $UserRole.DeveloperName = 'Support_Coach' ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You are not allowed to link this Dispute case to a FraudX case.
